steps: Boil 1 egg for 8 minutes for a firm yolk, then cool under cold water and peel.
Dice the cucumber and tomato small and toss to make 100 g of chopped salad; season with salt.
Halve the egg and plate it with the salad, 40 g white cheese and the bread roll.
Boil 1 egg for 8 minutes, then cool under cold water and peel.
Slice 50 g tomato and toast the slice of bread.
Plate the halved egg with the tomato, 30 g olives and the toast.
